integrity.finite_evidence: verify.py enumerates 9840 words and constructs a 65-symbol morphism prefix.
integrity.proof_dependency: Published Theorems 1 and 14 of arXiv:2206.01776v1; exhaustive finite reflection obstruction independently checked from definitions.
integrity.unproved_claims: No general reflection formula for arbitrary ternary morphisms is claimed.
